notes.zh: 勘察天体时，隐藏事件 ancrel.9999（on_survey_planet）以 5/405 的机会生成一个随机考古遗址（AI帝国或5年内刚发现过遗址者机会×0.2），再按各遗址的权重抽取；本遗址要求 has_shroud_dlc，权重+50，出现在有毒星球（pc_toxic）上。
notes.en: When a body is surveyed, hidden ancrel.9999 (on_survey_planet) has a 5/405 chance to create a random dig site (×0.2 for AI empires or if a site was found in the last 5 years), then picks a site type by weight; this site needs has_shroud_dlc and has weight +50 on toxic planets (pc_toxic).

scope.zh: 整条故事：遗址的出现方式、全部阶段（按定义顺序）、最后结果及其互斥关系、掷骰失败时的事件池；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: how the site appears, every stage in definition order, the final outcome(s) and their exclusivity, the roll-failure incident pool; both languages read.
